payload.snippet: Microsoft (MSFT) stock fell 3.5% over the latest trading session, a dip that has it trading about 34% below its 52-week high. For a systems software giant performing strongly, it’s a notable move. On its latest earnings call, management reported its AI business surpassed a $37 billion annual run rate, up 123%, while the Microsoft Cloud segment exceeded $54 billion in quarterly revenue.
